LuaFunction.Description: Returns the distance to alignment for an axle counter sensor, either +/- 1.5 in schematic drawings or otherwise +/-0.75.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_TEL_LateralOffset() local cg2 = Alignment.AlignmentSystem.CantGauge/2 if SymbolMode == "Schematic" then return RightSided and 2 or -2 --TODO: Only guessing... else return NOBN_trk_getLateralOffsetFromCantAndTrackPlaneDistance(RightSided and cg2 or -cg2) end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_TEL_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a text string 'DownSection/UpSection' for an axle counter sensor.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_TEL_code() local first = "-" local shortestDistanceSoFar = math.huge for i = 0, DownSections.Count-1 do local obj = DownSections[i] if obj and obj:isVisible() then local dist = getDistance(obj) if dist < shortestDistanceSoFar then first = DownSections[i].code shortestDistanceSoFar = dist end end end local second = "-" shortestDistanceSoFar = math.huge for i = 0, UpSections.Count-1 do local obj = UpSections[i] if obj and obj:isVisible() then local dist = getDistance(obj) if dist < shortestDistanceSoFar then second = UpSections[i].code shortestDistanceSoFar = dist end end end if MileageIncreasesTowardsLeft then first, second = second, first end if first == "-" and second == "-" then return first.."/"..second, _info("UNFINISHED - Create axle counter Section object(s) to obtain the section numbers 'a/b' for the sensor.") else return first.."/"..second end end

CustomProperty.Name: Mounting
CustomProperty.Description: The axle counter tuning unit may be mounted as [ Flat | Upright | Wall | As number two ]. The flat mounting (aka 'mushroom') means a flat-lying tuning unit mounted on top of a short pole, the pole's foot is meant for shallow burying in ballast. The upright method implies a slightly taller ballast foot with an upright tuning unit mounted to the side of this pole. The wall method has no foot, just a bracket allowing fitting of an upright tuning unit to a wall, for instance in a tunnel under the hand rail.

Value.Description: Flat-lying tuning unit mounted on top of a short pole with a ballast-buried foot.
Upright tuning unit mounted to the side of a medium tall pole with a ballast-buried foot.
Upright tuning unit without pole or foot, for fitting to a wall.
Upright tuning unit without pole or foot, for fitting to an existing other upright tuning.

CustomProperty.Name: CableLength
CustomProperty.Description: The axle counter tuning unit will usually benefit from a pre-fabricated standard coaxial cable with a low-pass filter. These cable come in a several standard lengths. The cable will be descend from the track-mounted sensor into the ballast, typically follow the ballast under the cable duct, turning left or right, then mounting along the foot of the axle counter tuning unit stand. Therefore, the required cable length is approcimately 0.3m + LateralOffset + AlongOffset + 0.7m = 1m + LateralOffset + AlongOffset. One supplier has standard coax cables of lengths 4, 5.5 or 8 meter. Another supplier has standard coax cable lengths up to 15m.

Value.Description: Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 6.0 to 14.0 meters
Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 4.5 to 6.0 meters
Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 3.0 to 4.5 meters
Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 2.5 to 3.0 meters

CustomProperty.Name: mc_CableDistanceFromTuningUnitToAxleCounter
CustomProperty.DisplayName: Cable distance from tuning unit to axle counter sensor
CustomProperty.Description: Axle counters send very weak signals to the nearby tuning unit, using impedance-matched coaxial cables of predefined lengths, typically 4, 5.5, 8 or 15 meters.

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_TET_chkCableDistanceFromTuningUnitToAxleCounter()
LuaFunction.Description: Checks 'grid distance' (perp to track + along track), from axle counter tuning unit to its axle counter sensor. Error if more than 1 meter outside stated tolerance, warning if outside expected value but less than 1 meter off.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_TET_chkCableDistanceFromTuningUnitToAxleCounter() --Assume tuning unit has same own alignment and approximate position as the axle counter it belongs to: local s = rel_AxleCounterTuningUnit_FeedsAndReads_AxleCounter local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Relate with '"..s.."' to its axle counter sensor." else local tol = 1.0 -- meter local lo = { SHORT = 2.5, MEDIUM = 3.0, LONG = 4.5, EXTRALONG = 6.0 } local hi = { SHORT = 3.0, MEDIUM = 4.5, LONG = 6.0, EXTRALONG = 14.0 } local cLen = { SHORT = "short", MEDIUM = "medium", LONG = "long", EXTRALONG = "extra long" } lo = lo[CableLength] hi = hi[CableLength] cLen = cLen[CableLength] local ac = r[0] --trigger modelcheck in related objects as well local gridLateralOffset = math.abs(LateralOffset - ac.LateralOffset) local gridAlongOffset = math.abs(Mileage - ac.Mileage) -- Their sum is a square-grid metric: local gridDistance = RC__round(gridLateralOffset + gridAlongOffset,1) local msg = "Grid distance is the sum of "..RC__round(gridLateralOffset,1).." (perpendicular to alignment) and "..RC__round(gridAlongOffset,1).." (along the alignment)" local gt = string.format("%.1f=%.03f+%.03f", gridDistance, gridLateralOffset, gridAlongOffset) if (gridDistance < lo-tol) then return gt..": ERROR - Tuner is located too close to axle counter wrt minimum tolerance, change prefab cable length.",{ac},_error, _info(msg) elseif (gridDistance >= lo-tol and gridDistance < lo) then return gt..": WARNING - Tuner is located close to axle counter but above the minimum - try increase to " ..lo..".",{ac},_warning, _info(msg) elseif (gridDistance >= lo and gridDistance < hi) then return gt..": OK - Distance from tuner to axle counter is suitable for the "..cLen.." cable type",{ac},_ok, _info(msg) elseif (gridDistance >= hi and gridDistance <= hi+tol) then return gt..": WARNING - Tuner is located far from axle counter, but below the maximum - try reduce to "..hi..".",{ac},_warning, _info(msg) else return gt..": ERROR - Tuner is located too far from axle counter, change prefab cable length.",{ac},_error, _info(msg) end end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_TET_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the 'code' for axle counter tuning unit. Uses relation '"..rel_AxleCounterTuningUnit_FeedsAndReads_AxleCounter.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_TET_code() s = "Er akseltellersopp for tellepunkt" r, n = RC__getCollectionOfRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Relate with '"..s.."' to its axle counter sensor." elseif n == 1 then return tostring(r[0].code) elseif n == 2 then return r[0].code.."+"..r[1].code else return "*** ERROR - Too many axle counters sensors related to mushroom with '"..s.."." end end

CustomProperty.Name: NamePlateText
CustomProperty.Description: Holds the section numbers to be displayed on the 3D geometry's name plate. The numbers are arranged such that the detection section number at lower mileage is mentioned on the side of the board being closest to the low mileages. The text is parsed from the associated axle counter's code.

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_TET_NamePlateText3D()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the section numbers to show on the 3D geometry's name plate.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_TET_NamePlateText3D() local s = rel_AxleCounterTuningUnit_FeedsAndReads_AxleCounter local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Relate with '"..s.."' to its axle counter sensor." else local acc = r[0].code local lo, hi if acc == "-/-" then return "-/-" elseif acc:match("%w+/%-") then lo = acc:match("(%w+)/%-") hi = "-" elseif acc:match("%-/%w+") then lo = "-" hi = acc:match("%-/(%w+)") else lo, hi = acc:match("(%w+)/(%w+)") end return dir == "both" and hi.."/"..lo or lo.."/"..hi end end

CustomProperty.Name: Mounting
CustomProperty.Description: The FTGS tuning unit may be mounted as [ Flat | Upright | Wall ]. The flat (aka 'mushroom') mounting means a flat-lying tuning unit mounted on top of a short pole, the pole's foot is meant for shallow burying in ballast. The upright method implies a slightly taller ballast foot with an upright tuning unit mounted to the side of this pole. The wall method has no foot, just a bracket allowing fitting of an upright tuning unit to a wall, for instance in a tunnel under the hand rail.

Value.Description: Flat-lying tuning unit mounted on top of a short pole with a ballast-buried foot.
Upright tuning unit mounted to the side of a medium tall pole with a ballast-buried foot.
Upright tuning unit without pole or foot, for fitting to a wall.

CustomProperty.Name: CableLength
CustomProperty.Description: The FTGS tuning unit will usually benefit from a pre-fabricated standard coaxial cable with a low-pass filter. These cable come in a several standard lengths. The cable will be descend from the track-mounted sensor into the ballast, typically follow the ballast under the cable duct, turning left or right, then mounting along the foot of the axle counter tuning unit stand. Therefore, the required cable length is approcimately 0.3m + LateralOffset + AlongOffset + 0.7m = 1m + LateralOffset + AlongOffset. One supplier has standard coax cables of lengths 4, 5.5 or 8 meter. Another supplier has standard coax cable lengths up to 15m.

Value.Description: Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 6.0 to 14.0 meters
Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 4.5 to 6.0 meters
Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 3.0 to 4.5 meters
Lateral offset plus along-offset should be around 2.5 to 3.0 meters

CustomProperty.Name: mc_CableDistanceFromTuningUnitToFtgsConnector
CustomProperty.DisplayName: Cable distance from tuning unit to FTGS connector
CustomProperty.Description: FTGS connectors send very weak signals to the nearby tuning unit, using impedance-matched coaxial cables of predefined lengths, typically from 4 to 15 meters.

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_SFT_chkCableDistanceFromTuningUnitToFtgsConnector()
LuaFunction.Description: Checks 'grid distance' (perp to track + along track), from axle counter tuning unit to its axle counter sensor. Error if more than 1 meter outside stated tolerance, warning if outside expected value but less than 1 meter off.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_SFT_chkCableDistanceFromTuningUnitToFtgsConnector() --Assume FTGS mushroom has same own alignment and approximate position as the FTGS feed / return it belongs to: local s = rel_FtgsSbond_IsFedAndReadBy_FtgsTuningUnit local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Relate with '"..s.."' to its FTGS connector." else local tol = 1.0 -- meter local lo = { SHORT = 2.5, MEDIUM = 3.0, LONG = 4.5, EXTRALONG = 6.0 } local hi = { SHORT = 3.0, MEDIUM = 4.5, LONG = 6.0, EXTRALONG = 14.0 } local cLen = { SHORT = "short", MEDIUM = "medium", LONG = "long", EXTRALONG = "extra long" } lo = lo[CableLength] hi = hi[CableLength] cLen = cLen[CableLength] local fc = r[0] --trigger modelcheck in related objects as well local gridLateralOffset = math.abs(LateralOffset - fc.LateralOffset) local gridAlongOffset = math.abs(Mileage - fc.Mileage) -- Their sum is a square-grid metric: local gridDistance = RC__round(gridLateralOffset + gridAlongOffset,1) local msg = "Grid distance is the sum of "..RC__round(gridLateralOffset,1).." (perpendicular to alignment) and "..RC__round(gridAlongOffset,1).." (along the alignment)" local gt = string.format("%.1f=%.03f+%.03f", gridDistance, gridLateralOffset, gridAlongOffset) if (gridDistance < lo-tol) then return gt..": ERROR - Tuner is located too close to axle counter wrt minimum tolerance, change prefab cable length.",{fc},_error, _info(msg) elseif (gridDistance >= lo-tol and gridDistance < lo) then return gt..": WARNING - Tuner is located close to axle counter but above the minimum - try increase to " ..lo..".",{fc},_warning, _info(msg) elseif (gridDistance >= lo and gridDistance < hi) then return gt..": OK - Distance from tuner to axle counter is suitable for the "..cLen.." cable type",{ac},_ok, _info(msg) elseif (gridDistance >= hi and gridDistance <= hi+tol) then return gt..": WARNING - Tuner is located far from axle counter, but below the maximum - try reduce to "..hi..".",{fc},_warning, _info(msg) else return gt..": ERROR - Tuner is located too far from axle counter, change prefab cable length.",{fc},_error, _info(msg) end end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_SFT_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the 'code' for FTGS connector tuning unit. Uses relation '"..rel_FtgsSbond_IsFedAndReadBy_FtgsTuningUnit.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_SFT_code() local s = rel_FtgsSbond_IsFedAndReadBy_FtgsTuningUnit local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Relate with '"..s.."' to its FTGS connector." elseif n == 1 then return "Ftu("..r[0].code..")" elseif n == 2 then return "Ftu("..r[0].code.."+"..r[1].code..")" elseif n >= 3 then return "ERROR - Too many FTGS connectors related to FTGS tuning unit with '"..s.."." end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_SFT_Geometry3DName()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the '3D geometry name' for the FTGS connector tuning unit. Uses relation '"..rel_FtgsSbond_IsFedAndReadBy_FtgsTuningUnit.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_SFT_Geometry3DName() local t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-SFT-SPORFELT-TUNINGENHET-FTGS" if Mounting == "FLAT" then return t.."-FLATT" elseif Mounting == "UPRIGHT" then return t.."-OPPREIST" elseif Mounting == "WALL" then return t.."-VEGG" end return t.."Bad Variant ["..Variant.."]." end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_DRV_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the code for a point machine, derived from the switch it is related to with '"..rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_DRV_code() local s, r, n, sw, pm, nPm, i, j, d s = rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "Relate with '"..s.."' to switch object (turnout).", _info("Point machines derive their code from the switch they are related to with '"..s.."'.") else sw = r[0] pm, nPm = getRelatedObjects(rel_Switch_Has_PointMachine, sw) j = 0 for i = 0, nPm-1 do d = (sw.dir == "up") and 1 or -1 if ((ReferenceMileage - pm[i].ReferenceMileage)*d >= 0) then j = j + 1 end end return tonumber(sw.code) and string.format("%d.%d",sw.code, j) or string.format("%s.%d",sw.code, j) end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_DRV_dir()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the direction (dir) for a point machine, derived from the switch it is related to with '"..rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_DRV_dir() local s, sw, n s = rel_PointMachine_BelongsTo_Switch sw, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "unknown", _info("Point machines derive their direction from the switch they are related to with '"..s.."'.") else return sw[0].dir end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_DRV_Geometry3DName()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the 3D geometry's 'Name' for a point machine, derived from its Variant, direction (dir) and side of alignment (distanceToAlignment).
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_DRV_Geometry3DName() local t = "" if Variant == "Unspecified" then return "NO-BN-3D-FE-DIV-UKJENT" elseif Variant == "Alstom MET" then t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-DRV-SPORVEKSELDRIVMASKIN-ALSTOM-MET-" elseif Variant == "Siemens Bsg9" then t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-DRV-SPORVEKSELDRIVMASKIN-SIEMENS-BSG9-" elseif Variant == "Siemens ELS 710" then t = "NO-BN-3D-SA-DRV-SPORVEKSELDRIVMASKIN-SIEMENS-ELS710-" else return "NO-BN-3D-FE-DIV-UKJENT",_error, _info("Unrecognized variant ["..Variant.."].") end if ((dir == "up" and RightSided) or (dir == "down" and LeftSided)) then return t.."HSIDE" elseif ((dir == "up" and LeftSided) or (dir == "down" and RightSided)) then return t.."VSIDE" else return "Cannot determine side of track for point machine.",_error end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_SPD_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the code for a derailer machine, derived from the derailer it is related to with '"..rel_DerailerMachine_BelongsTo_Derailer.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_SPD_code() local s = rel_DerailerMachine_BelongsTo_Derailer local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Missing relation '"..s.."' to derailer object.",_warning else return r[0].code end end

LuaFunction.Description: Returns the code for a local control panel, derived from the switch or derailer it is related to with '"..rel_LocalControlPanel_Actuates_SwitchOrDerailer.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTSA_LOK_code() local s = rel_LocalControlPanel_Actuates_SwitchOrDerailer local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Missing relation '"..s.."' to switch object or derailer object.",_warning, _info("A local control panel derives its code property from the switch or derailer which it is related to.") elseif n == 1 then if r[0].RcType == rctype_Switch then local coupledSwitch, ncsw = getRelatedObjects(rel_Switch_IsCoupledWith_Switch, r[0]) if ncsw == 0 then return r[0].code else return coupledSwitch[0].code.."/"..r[0].code end elseif r[0].RcType == rctype_Derailer then return r[0].code else return "ERROR - Bad RcType ["..r[0].RcType.."] for object related to Local control panel.",_error end else return "ERROR - More than 1 ["..n.."] object related to Local control panel.",_error end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTSA_LOK_dir()
